environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application handles authentication via X-Authenticated-User header set by an upstream OAuth proxy, but the /api/users/search endpoint does not enforce authentication checks in code.

config.alb_rules: Default action: forward to target group, no additional rules
